Commentary.Commentary: Earlier, Shafiq also batted solidly to stitch a crucial 115-run stand along with Azhar Ali to steer Pakistan to safe harbours. Bird was the standout bowler and bowled with great rhythm. Hazlewood also shone with the ball and both of them scalped three wickets apiece. Australia need to bat really well now. The home side will be coming hard at them with the ball. Let's see who comes out on top.

And here comes the declaration after Azhar Ali's fabulous double ton. They have dominated the proceedings completely today and have lit up the MCG with free spirited strokeplay. It was the 8th wicket 118-run stand between Azhar Ali and Sohail Khan that gave the much-needed momentum to Pakistan and they are poised nicely at the moment.

OUT! 100th Test wicket for Hazlewood as well. Bowls a shortish delivery on middle and leg, Riaz stands tall and heaves across the line but only gets a top edge that lobs back towards Hazlewood. He comes under it and pouches it safely. The away team has posted a huge score on the board! PAKISTAN HAVE DECLARED ON 443/9!
Stays back to the back of a length ball and defends it to the covers.
Fuller length ball outside off, Riaz throws his bat at it but misses.
A well directed yorker as Ali digs it out towards gully.
FOUR! SHOT! Fuller length ball outside off, Ali drives it nicely with an open face behind point and the ball races to the fence.
2nd Double Ton for Azhar Ali.

WHAT A KNOCK BY ALI! He thumps the air in delight and raises his arms skywards. He has played with so much of poise and grace and the Melbourne crowd rises up on its feet! A thoroughly well-deserved double ton. Fullish and straying on the pads, Ali clips it through backward square leg and comes back for a couple.
Fullish ball outside off, driven through covers for a single. Ali is on strike now.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Short of a length outside off, Ali arches back and glides it to third man for a single.
WAHAB RIAZ is the next man in.

OUT! GREAT RUN OUT BY MADDINSON! Short of a length on middle and leg, Ali tucks it with soft hands towards square leg and sets off for a run. Sohail Khan is a bit slow to get off his blocks as Maddinson comes charging in and flicks in an underarm throw at the striker's end. Scores a direct hit as Khan drags his bat in. Looks like it will be touch and go. Time for the replays. It shows that his bat is grounded just on the crease as the bails come off. Nothing behind the crease and the TV umpire rules it out. Low game awareness from him and he pays the price.
A run out appeal has been referred upstairs. It's against Sohail Khan. Looks very close to the naked eye.
Fullish ball outside off, angling in. Azhar pushes it off the inner half of his bat to mid on.
Fullish and it's straying on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a couple. Moves to 198.
On a length nipping in a shade, Azhar plants his front foot forward and defends it to the off side.
On a length outside off, Ali leans forward and defends it confidently.
Bowls a fullish ball around off, Ali shuffles and clips it towards mid on.

Welcome back for the second session of play. Pakistan will probably declare after Azhar Ali's double ton and the ball completely lies in their court. JOSH HAZLEWOOD to bowl first up after Lunch. It's bright and sunny now. Let's see how things unfold...
...DAY 3, SESSION 2...

Misbah's men will be patting themselves to have crossed the 400-run mark for the second time in a row and it could be just a matter of time before they declare as they will just wait for Azhar Ali to register his second double ton of the year. The Australians have been made to toil hard for wickets and they would very well know the momentum is with Pakistan and they too have some quality bowling in their ranks to push the hosts on the back foot. One thing is guaranteed, the home side will come out to bat soon in the next session and let's hope the weather remains kind. Join us back shortly for an entertaining afternoon session...

Pakistan have taken another session in their kitty. We have seen everything in this session, a delay, then again a delay, a wicket and then lots of runs, 123 to be precise! Azhar Ali though has kept the limelight with him but to be honest Sohail Khan has dragged it in his favour. One may argue it was more of a declaration batting but you need guts to take the attack to an opposition like Australia. He came in with an intention and entertained one and all with his run-a-ball 65 and has grown in confidence after each stroke he played. Pakistan needed the tail to wag around Ali and they have done exactly that.

FOUR! More runs, they keep flowing for Pakistan! Fuller and sprayed on the pads, Sohail Khan looks to flick and it seemed like it went off the pads towards fine leg. They all wait for the umpire and he signals it as runs off the blade. The bails come off and that shall be LUNCH ON DAY 3!

FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard! Starc hurls a back of a length ball outside off, width on offer and Sohail Khan rides the bounce as he cuts it hard through backward point for a rocketing boundary. It crossed the ropes before I could even blink. Note - This is also the highest 8th-wicket stand for Pakistan in Tests, that is some feat!
Fires a yorker into the blockhole but Sohail Khan brings his bat down to keep it at bay.
Fuller outside off, Azhar comes forward and drives it through covers. The outfield has got some beating due to the rain and hence the ball slows down. Three runs picked up.
Fuller in length and around off, pushed towards covers.

FOUR! Ahh, this is class apart batting! On a length and just outside off, Ali is firm in his crease, opens the face of the bat and glides it between second slip and gully for a boundary to move into 190s!
Loopy around off, defended down gently.
100-run stand between Ali and Khan!

SIX! Kaboom! He has picked the bones outta that one! Tossed up around middle and off, Khan gets down on one knee and brings out the slog sweep. Makes fabulous connection and sends it soaring over the long on fence for a maximum.
Worked away towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up around middle and off, Ali comes down the track to defend it.
Full and around off, defended off the front foot.
Short and around off, punched towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Frustration continues for the Aussies! Short and outside off, Ali keeps his bat skywards and gets it easily over gully for another boundary. Terrific stuff from the visitors.
Maiden Test fifty for Sohail Khan!

FIFTY FOR SOHAIL KHAN! Superbly done, mate! Removes the helmet and sinks the appreciation that is on offer for him. Fuller in length and angling in, Sohail works it through the gap at mid-wicket for three runs.
Mitchell fires in a yorker on middle, Khan jams it out back to the bowler.
Fuller and angling in, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Short of a length ball outside off, Khan lets it go.
Starc comes from around the wicket and serves a low full toss on off, pushed towards sweeper cover for a single.
MITCHELL STARC is back on!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

In the air... safe! Sohail Khan has some luck with him! You don't see David Warner letting go such chances! Drags the length short this time, Khan looks to hit it across the line. Gets a top edge towards backward square leg where Warner completely misjudges it and the ball falls safely. Two runs added to the total.

SIX! This is even hugeeeeee! Lyon once again tosses it up around middle and off, Sohail Khan is in some mood here. Gets in the line and goes bang over long on for back-to-back maximums. What a catch in the crowd! 400 up for Pakistan and in some style.
SIX! All hail Sohail! He is turning it on here by swinging the bat! Tossed up around middle and leg, Khan gets low in the crease and thumps it over mid-wicket for a biggie all the way.
Outside off, turning in, defended towards the leg side.
Loopy ball around off, Sohail presents full face of the bat as he drives it back to Nathan.
The sucker ball as you would call it! Bird fires in a yorker on the stumps, Ali jams it out back to Bird.

Short of a length ball outside off, Ali arches back and waits for the ball to come. He gets low in the crease and cuts it very late towards gully where the fielder dives full length to his right to make a stop.
On a length and around off, touch short as well, Azhar pushes it towards point.
Sohail Khan looks to defend this length ball and gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Nailed it, Sohail! A length ball on middle and off, Khan stays put and pulls it in front of square for a boundary.
Shortish on off, defended off the back foot.
Full around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Swung across the line! Lyon bowls a tossed up ball around off, Sohail skips down the track and gives it a full swing of the bat. Gets enough blade on it as it clears the cow corner fence with utmost ease for a biggie.
Around middle and off, defended off the back foot.

Outside off, turns in viciously as Khan looks to flick it away on the leg side but fails to get any wood on it. The ball goes towards fine leg and they try to steal byes. Umpire Ravi feels he didn't offer any stroke and hence no runs will be given.
Loopy ball around off, turns in again, Khan looks to defend but misses and is hit on the thigh pad again.

A shout for lbw, not given! Tosses it up outside off, turning in sharply, Sohail looks to hit this across the line with the spin but misses and is hit on the back pad. Lyon appeals but umpire S Ravi isn't interested.

FOUR! Rides the bounce on this occasion! Jackson shortens the length this time but it sits up at a nice height for Azhar. He swivels a bit and pulls it on the up through square leg for another boundary in this over. Moves into 180s!
Good length ball on off, AA gets behind the line and offers a straight bat.
In the corridor outside off, Azhar shoulders his arms.
Good comeback from Bird! On a length and angling in, Ali tries to fiddle with it as the ball just whistles past the outside edge to the keeper.

FOUR! How about that? What a shot! Azhar has played the on and off drives so well all throughout this innings. Bird serves him an overpitched ball on off, Ali leans ahead and caresses it down the ground past mid on for a boundary to get going after the break.
We are back. Bird will continue his over and Azhar Ali to take strike. Here we go...

Here comes the drizzle again! Out come the groundsmen with covers. The main strip has been taken care of. It's pretty light at the moment. The radar shows that most of the clouds have passed over the MCG. There is also a strong breeze blowing across the ground. Looks like it will only be a brief halt. Will this make the Pakistanis declare or will they wait for Azhar Ali to complete his double ton?
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Loopy ball well outside off, Khan looks to play at it but is beaten.
A touch short and wide outside off, cut through cover-point nicely. Three runs taken!
Comes around the wicket and slides it across Ali. He prod forward to defend but is beaten.
Shortish delivery, punched through the covers for a run.

FOUR! SMITH ALMOST PULLED OFF A SPECTACULAR CATCH THERE! Bowls it shortish and wide outside off, Sohail bends low and scoops it past the keeper. Smith anticipated that to perfection and ran to his left but the ball brushes the fingertips of his right hand and races to the fine leg fence.
Short delivery, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to mid off.
FOUR! LUCKY RUNS! Bowls a fullish ball wider outside off, Sohail goes for an ambitious drive but gets a thick outside edge behind point and gets a handy boundary.
Back of a length ball outside off, Khan looks to defend it but gets an outside edge past gully. Couple taken!
Fuller length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Dug in short outside off, Sohail looks to hook it but misses.
Back of a length around off, tucked to the leg side for a run.
Khan comes forward to this one and defends it.
Fullish delivery, worked with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

AN APPEAL FOR LBW TURNED DOWN! Floats it up on off, Ali goes for the lap sweep and seems to have got it from his bat. Wade goes up in a loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Couple taken! The Hotspot shows there was an under edge on that one.

FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Loopy ball well outside off, Azhar dances down the track and drives it on the up over covers. Good timing on that one and the ball races to the fence. A declaration might be around the corner.
Tossed up outside off, defended with the spin down the track.
Time for Drinks.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Hurls in a length ball wider outside off, Khan looks to play at it but gets beaten.
OUCH! THAT MUST HAVE HURT! Bowls a length delivery and it's angling in, Khan hops back and looks to work it across but gets an inside edge onto the abdomen area.
THAT'S A PEACH! Bowls a length ball outside off, Khan feels for it but is beaten by the away movement. Nice seam position on that one!
Ali walks down the pitch and places the short of the length delivery outside off through the off side. Single taken!
Fullish ball outside off, driven firmly to the covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground
Ali eases this one with the spin through mid on for a run.
Gives this one plenty of air outside off, Azhar looks to sweep it hard again but misses.
Ali waits for it and defends it with the spin to the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, Ali looks to sweep it hard but misses. Hotspot shows there was something on the bat there. There was no appeal from the Aussies.
THAT SPUN AND BOUNCED SHARPLY! Bowls it well outside off, Azhar comes forward to defend but is beaten by the sharp inward spin as the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
NATHAN LYON to bowl now. A huge cheer for him as he takes his strides.
On a length outside off, swinging away. Sohail stays back and makes a watchful leave.
Tests him up with the short stuff again as Khan ducks and evades the bumper.
Dug in very short, Khan has no trouble in ducking under it.
Fuller length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
In the channel outside off, shapes away after pitching. Khan doesn't flirt with that one.
On a length on the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
JACKSON BIRD into the attack.
On a length on the stumps, Khan covers the line and defends it down the track.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short of a length ball on the hips, tucked to fine leg for a run.

FOUR! HIGHEST SCORE FOR A PAKISTANI BATSMAN IN AUSTRALIA IN TESTS! Bowls a fullish delivery outside off, Ali goes for a drive but gets an outside edge past second slip and the ball races to the third man fence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish delivery, pushed with soft hands to the leg side for a single. He gets off strike!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller length ball outside off, Ali drives it on the up over covers and gets a couple to his name. The field came up and he took the aerial route.

Goes wider of the crease and hurls in a fullish ball on the stumps, Khan stays well balanced and clips it through mid-wicket nicely. There is no protection in the deep and Maddinson has to run all the way from short leg to cut it off. Three runs taken!
Bowls a bouncer at 141.7 clicks outside off, Sohail ducks under it.
Shortish delivery on middle and leg, tucked to the leg side for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Ali camps back and defends it nicely.
Short of a length ball outside off, Khan plays it with an angled bat to point.

FOUR! STREAKY RUNS! Bowls a fuller length ball wide outside off, Khan goes for a drive on the up but gets a thick outside edge that flies past Khawaja at third slip. He picked it up pretty late and didn't dive. Khan gets a boundary to his name.
Dug in short, Khan ducks under it.
Fullish delivery, defended solidly off the front foot. There is a nice breeze blowing across the MCG. Just the kind of conditions a seam bowler dreams of.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Stays back to the length ball on the stumps and defends it nicely down the track.
150 up for Azhar Ali.

FOUR! WELL PLAYED! Shortish delivery slanting across Azhar. He camps back and cuts it behind point and the ball races to the fence. It has been a brilliant knock and the crowd acknowledges his efforts. Can he score a double ton?
Fuller length ball outside off, driven nicely to the covers.
Shortish delivery on middle and leg, Ali swivels across and pulls it nicely through backward square leg. Hazlewood cuts it off and keeps it down to two.
Shortish delivery wide outside off, Ali cuts it hard but finds Lyon at point who is standing a bit deep.
Short of a length around the hips, Ali looks to tuck it away but misses. Leg slip can come into play.
Camps back to the length delivery and defends it to the covers.
Leg slip in place.
Fuller length ball outside off curving back in. Sohail plays a loose shot across the line but gets beaten as the ball whizzes inches away past the off pole.
Dug in short this time, Khan ducks under it.
WELL BOWLED! Bowls a length delivery outside off, holds its line. Sohail feels for it but gets beaten all ends up.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller length ball on off, Sohail with his exaggerated followthrough of the bat defends it to the leg side.
Back of a length ball angling in, Ali shuffles and tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls a yorker length ball on middle and off, Khan is alert to it and digs it out nicely to short leg. End of a successful over by Starc!
Fullish delivery and straying on the pads, clipped nicely with soft hands through mid-wicket. Khan gets off the mark with a couple.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Dug in short but gets it down the leg side, Sohail ducks easily under it to evade it.
Tests him with a bouncer first up, Khan ducks underneath it.
SOHAIL KHAN comes out to bat.

OUT! STARC GETS HIS FIRST! Back of a length delivery attacking the body, Amir looks to glance it but only manages to get a fine tickle on it. Wade moves to his right and takes a regulation catch. Just the start the Aussies needed this morning to spur them up. The breezy 49-run stand comes to an end. Good contribution from Amir as he has done his job.
Tests him with a bouncer outside off and Ali is up to it as he sways away from the line of the delivery with good technique.
Length delivery well outside off, left alone.
Short of a length around off, Ali stays back and defends it towards mid on.
Gets behind the line to this length delivery and defends it.
Dug in short but it's slanting down leg, Ali lets it go through. Wade dives athletically to his left to make a good stop.
Length delivery slanting across Amir. He drives it with an open face through covers for a single.
Full length ball outside off, Azhar bends low and looks to drive but mistimes it towards covers.
On a length around off, defended solidly off the back foot to mid off.
Straying on the hips, tucked nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
On a length angling away, Ali is a bit tentative with his foot movement as he defends it down the track.
Short of a length ball around off, Ali hangs back and defends it to the covers.
Angles across a length delivery from Ali. He doesn't flirt with that one.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Azhar leans into the drive and creams it through the covers. Sharp running between the wickets fetches them three.
Just back of a length outside off, Ali points his bat skywards and allows it through. Hazlewood is a treat to watch. He is so consistent with his line and length outside off.
Camps back to the length delivery outside off and pushes it to the covers.
On a length outside off, holding its line. Ali comes forward and makes a watchful leave.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, driven firmly to mid on for nothing.
Fullish delivery well outside off drawing Azhar into the drive but he gets beaten. Good line and length to bowl this!
JOSH HAZLEWOOD to bowl from the other end.
It's shortish and going down leg, Amir looks to tuck it but misses.
Comes around the wicket and angles across a short delivery from Amir. He sways away from the line of the delivery.
Fullish and straying on the pads, clipped nicely to fine leg. First runs of the day!
Fullish delivery on middle and off, Ali shuffles a touch and defends it to short mid-wicket.

We are ready to start the first session. Let's hope we don't have any further rain delays today. AZHAR ALI will take strike and MOHAMMAD AMIR is at the non-striker's end.  MITCHELL STARC to continue his over. Here we go...
UPDATE 0440 IST - Great news! The covers are coming off and the word is that if there is no further interruption from the rain, play will start at 0505 IST.
UPDATE 0430 IST - Good news, folks! The rain has stopped at the moment but there will be a bit of delay as the conditions will be assessed. Let's see when the covers are taken off.

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 3 of the second Test between Australia and Pakistan. The weather has been dodgy so far with only over 100 overs bowled in two days and to add to the misery, it is drizzling at the moment at the MCG. The entire square has been covered up and the waiting game begins early in the morning. The early start that was scheduled to be at 0430 IST won't be possible. Let's hope we get some positive news soon and the weather clears out. Stay tuned as we will keep you posted.
...DAY 3, SESSION 1...

Let's hope the weather clears out tomorrow and we get in a full day's play or this Test could be heading towards a draw. There will be another half an hour early start tomorrow at 0430 IST to rope in the extra overs. We hope you enjoyed our coverage today. Till then, goodbye and take care!

After the tourists lost Sarfraz rather quickly, Amir came in and made his intentions clear from the start. He threw caution to the wind and played a breezy knock. He has pushed the bowlers on the back foot with his aggressive approach. The visitors are poised nicely at the moment at 310/6 and with rain forecast for the remainder of the Test, it will be interesting to see for how long Pakistan bat. On the other hand, the Aussies would look to nip out Ali quickly tomorrow morning and clean the tail in a jiffy.

Good day for Pakistan as they have scored 168 runs and lost only two wickets. Azhar Ali has been rock solid and has batted with grit and determination. He is unbeaten on 139 and looks hungry for more. The second new ball did the trick for the home side as the seamers utilized the overcast conditions smartly. Bird was again the pick of the bowlers as he bowled terrific lines and lengths and kept the batsmen on their toes. He broke the crucial 115-run stand between Ali and Shafiq. Hazlewood played the perfect foil to him and swung the ball appreciably. He has figures of 26-11-33-2 and Smith would be proud of his efforts.
UPDATE 1215 IST - It continues to rain and the umpires have decided to call it a day. Only 50.3 overs were roped in on this start-stop kind of day! Stumps on Day 2!

Oh sigh! Here comes the drizzle again and Ian Gould calls for the covers to come back on. The players walk off the field slowly. It has been a start-stop day and continues to remain so. The groundsmen are covering the pitch and the surrounding area completely. Let's hope the weather clears out soon.

FOUR! ALI IN COMPLETE CONTROL! Shortish delivery wide outside off, Azhar rises with the bounce and places it between backward point and gully to perfection. He bisected the field to perfection as the ball races across the turf to the fence.
Digs this one short and angles it across Ali. He arches back and sways away from the line of the delivery.
Fullish on the stumps, driven to mid on.
WELL BOWLED! Bowls a slower one well outside off, Amir throws the kitchen skin at it but gets beaten.

FOUR! FRUSTRATION FOR AUSTRALIA! It has been all aggression from Amir and he gets his sixth boundary. Bowls a back of a length ball outside off, Amir slashes at it hard but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies over Khawaja's head at second slip and races to the fence. Smith is not pleased at all.
Back of a length around middle and leg, Amir rises with the bounce and defends it solidly.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! CRUNCHED! Amir is racing along! Bowls a full length ball wide outside off, Mohammad comes forward and drives it on the up through the covers. The fielder sprints after it and slows down near the fence but has enough legs to cross the boundary in the end.
JACKSON BIRD to bowl now.
Short of a length ball on off, Ali hops back uncomfortably and fends it to the leg side.
Comes back over the wicket to Ali and hurls in a fuller length ball outside off, Ali leans forward and creams it through the covers. Good running between the wickets to come back for a couple.
On a length on the stumps, defended solidly off the back foot.
WELL DIRECTED SHORT DELIVERY! Comes around the wicket and angles in a shortish delivery, Amir hops back and fends at it. The ball brushes his gloves and falls in front of the slip region.
Very full and well outside off, dug out to the off side by Ali. There was a massive gap between his bat and body there.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Azhar strides forward and plays a punchy drive down the ground. Didn't hit that hard but just timed it beautifully! Gets the desired result.
Short of a length directed at the body, Ali shuffles and tucks it towards square leg. A brisk single taken!
Fullish delivery outside off, Azhar comes forward and defends it to gully.
Back of a length outside off, punched to the covers.
On a length on off, Amir mistimes his drive towards covers and gets a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Dug in short outside off, Ali sways away from the line of the delivery to evade it.
Fullish delivery, Amir drives it towards Starc who stops it on his follow through.
FOUR! Bowls a short of a length ball and it's going down leg, Mohammad gets a tickle on it and the ball rolls across to the fine leg fence. Moves to 18 off 13 deliveries! Handy runs for Pakistan.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! AMIR IS LUCKY AGAIN! Bowls a shortish delivery wide outside off, Amir slashes at it and gets an outside edge. Beats Khawaja in the slip region and also eludes the diving man at fly slip and races to third man fence.

Slips this one on a length and down the leg side, Amir looks to clip it but misses and Wade pouches it safely. There is an appeal for a caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. Ooh.. wait! however, the hotspot shows there was a bit of a nick on that one. Amir survives!
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Bowls a fullish delivery on the stumps, Amir prods forward and drives it through mid off and gets a second boundary to his name.
STARC is back on for a bowl.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a length around off, Amir taps it towards covers and scurries through for a quick single. The running between the wickets has been really good today.

FOUR! LOOSE SHOT! Bowls it a little bit wide and short of a length outside off, Amir slashes at it hard but gets a thick outside edge that flies over Khawaja at second slip and runs through to the third man fence. Khawaja indicates to his teammates that he didn't pick it up.
On a length outside off, Mohammad points his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
Short of a length delivery around off, guided to gully.
Fullish delivery on the stumps, Amir plants his front foot forward and defends it towards mid on.
Straying on the pads, Amir nudges it round the corner to get off the mark!
Angles across a length delivery from Amir. He comes forward and leaves it alone.
Leg bye! On a length angling into Ali. He looks to clip it but is rapped on the thigh pad. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Fuller length ball around off, driven to mid off.
Short of a length ball, curving away. Ali shoulders his arms to let that through.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Fullish delivery, driven to mid off.
MOHAMMAD AMIR comes to bat.

OUT! GREAT COMEBACK BY AUSTRALIA! Sticks to his line and length in the corridor of uncertainty, Ahmed comes forward tentatively and pokes at it but gets a thick outside edge that flies towards Renshaw at first slip. He moves nicely to his right, crouches and takes a good low catch. Ahmed's short stay at the crease comes to an end. Can the Aussies bowl the visitors out under 300?
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
RASH SHOT BY AHMED! Bowls it on a length wide outside off, Ahmed bends low and goes for an ambitious drive on the up but gets beaten.
On a length angling back in. Ahmed shuffles across his off pole and defends it towards mid on.
Fuller length ball on off, driven to mid off.

Time for Drinks. The Australians have made the new ball talk and swung it around appreciably. The Pakistani batsmen have looked tentative at the crease. This is the last recognized pair for the away side and they would hope that they string in a big partnership. Can the Aussies nip away two or three more wickets before stumps today or will the visitors go on to post a reasonable total on the board?
Fullish delivery outside off, Ali comes forward and pushes it with soft hands to Warner at mid off.
Straying on the pads, worked round the corner for a run.
Hurls this one wide outside off, Ahmed doesn't flirt with it.
Back of a length ball angling in, Ali closes his bat face early as he looks to tuck it but gets a leading edge that falls safely to the covers. Single taken!
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Overpitched around off, Azhar strides forward confidently and drives it down the ground. The timing is delightful on that stroke and the ball races to the long on fence.
Sarfraz walks down the track and taps the length delivery to point for a quick single. Good batting by Sarfraz.
Some decent carry on that as Josh Hazlewood pitches this on an excellent length outside off, AA covers the line well and makes a rather watchful leave to end the over.
Extremely full and attacking the stumps, driven to the mid on region. No run taken though.
Good length delivery outside off, Azhar has nothing to do with that one.
Hazlewood fires this one right up there, around off, Azhar Ali pushes it to the cover region for a couple of runs.
Another delivery which is fullish in length, around off, blocked off the front foot and into the track.
Fuller length ball on the stumps, it's flicked to the square leg region for nothing.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD comes back to bowl.
On a length around off, played to point by Ahmed.
FOUR! STREAKY RUNS! Short of a length ball outside off, Sarfraz hangs back and plays at it but gets a thick outside edge that flies in between the slips and gully and races to the third man fence.
On a length outside of, holding it's line. Ahmed lets it go.
Sees him coming down the track and bowls a short delivery but it's going down leg as Sarfraz ducks and evades it.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ahmed lets it through.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller length ball around off, Ali comes forward and defends it to the off side.

SUPERB EFFORT BY WADE! Bowls a very short delivery on middle and leg, Ali ducks underneath it comfortably and Wade has to leap high in the air like a goal keeper to stop it. He does that to perfection!
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, driven nicely to Starc who stops it on his follow through.
Slips the length delivery down the leg side, Sarfraz fails to work it around.
Fullish delivery on leg stump, clipped nicely through widish mid on for a run.
Bowls a short of a length delivery at 144.3 clicks and it's slanting across Ahmed. He hangs his bat out tentatively but is beaten all ends up.
Fullish delivery and it's straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a run.
Shortish delivery wide outside off, Sarfraz camps back and punches it towards Lyon at point. He dives to his right to stop the ball but misfields a bit. Couple taken!
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length delivery rising up on Ali. He rises with the bounce and defends it nicely.
Short of a length on the stumps, Ahmed looks to tuck it but is rapped on the thigh pad. The ball rolls to the leg side as the batsmen cross over. Leg bye signaled by the umpire!
BEAUTIFULLY BOWLED! Bowls it back of a length outside off, Ahmed comes down the track and looks to block it but is beaten by the away movement.
Camps back and plays it with an angled blade to point.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it to the off side.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven with an open face to the off side.
FOUR! DELIGHTFUL! Bowls a fuller length ball around off, Ali prods forward and drives it elegantly down the ground and the ball whistles away to the fence. Great timing on that one!
Fullish delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
FIVE WIDES! That's a wayward delivery as it's dug in too short outside off, Wade leaps high in the air but to no avail and races to the fence. Five wides signaled by the umpire.
SARFRAZ AHMED walks in next.

OUT! BIRD GETS HIS THIRD! Removes him with a ripper! Bowls a back of a length delivery around off, moves away a shade after pitching. Asad has no choice but to go for a block and ends up getting a thick outside edge that flies at a fast pace towards Smith. It comes off at a comfortable height to the Aussie skipper and he pouches it safely at second slip. Shafiq departs just after reaching his fifty. The hosts have bowled well with the new ball and troubled the batsmen constantly. A crucial breakthrough for them! The brilliant 115-run stand off 247 balls comes to an end.
BRAVE LEAVE! Hurls this one closer to the off pole as Shafiq comes forward and lets it go through.
Fuller length ball outside off, shaping away. Shafiq lets it go.
On a length angling across Asad. He strides forward and pushes it to the off side.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Ali tucks it behind square on the leg side for a run.
18th Test Fifty up for Asad Shafiq.
Straying on the hips, Shafiq glances it down to fine leg for a single. It has been a well constructed knock and he needs to carry on.
JACKSON BIRD is back on.
Yorker length ball on the stumps, dug out nicely towards mid off.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Hurls this one wide outside off, Ali doesn't flirt with it.
Angles it in the channel across Ali. Left alone!
The batsman has played it to the point region
Short of a length ball angling away, Ali plays it with an angled blade to gully.

SHAFIQ SURVIVES AGAIN! Bowls a fullish delivery shaping back in on middle and leg, Shafiq falls over a bit and looks to play across the line but is rapped flush on the front pad. Another huge roar from the Aussies for a LBW but the umpire stays unmoved. Smith consults with Wade and Hazlewood and thinks about the review but doesn't take it. Good decision not to review it as the replays show that was going down leg.
Outside off, Shafiq lets it go.

A LOUD SHOUT FOR LBW TURNED DOWN! Bowls a fullish delivery tailing in and attacking the stumps, Shafiq looks to flick it but plays down the wrong line and is rapped low on the pads. The umpire shakes his head and turns down the LBW appeal. Smith thinks about the review but does not take it. The replays show that it would have probably gone down the leg side.
Another left alone outside off.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Slips this one down the leg side, Shafiq looks to clip it but misses.

NOT OUT! Bowls a full length ball wide outside off, Ali looks to jam it out but seems to have nicked it and Wade moves to his right and takes it quite low. There is a loud appeal for a caught behind from the Aussies but the umpires are not sure. They decide to refer it upstairs. Has Wade taken it cleanly? Hotspot confirms that it is off the bat but the replays are inconclusive whether Wade has taken the catch cleanly or not. Seems that the ball has kissed the ground as his fingers were pointing downwards. So, the soft signal remains and Ali survives.
The umpires refer a caught behind appeal upstairs. Is it a bump ball or has Wade taken it cleanly? The soft signal is not out.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total. The scoreboard is moving now.
FOUR LEG BYES! Straying on the hips, Shafiq looks to clip it but misses and the ball brushes his thigh pad and runs  to the fine leg fence. Four leg byes signaled by the umpire.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! Bowls a length delivery around off, Azhar taps it towards covers and sets off for a run. Lyon sprints in from point, cuts off the angle and gets to it in a flash. Picks it up and hurls in a throw at the non-striker's end but misses. Azhar was diving to get back in and looked like he would been a goner. The replays confirm that he was a mile out.
He is maintaining a consistent channel outside off and Ali continues with his circumspect approach as he leaves this one.
Hurls in a length ball and angles it away at 145 clicks from Ali. He lets it go through.
On a length attacking the stumps, Asad defends it off the inner half towards the covers. A good start with the new ball for the Aussies.
Gets his radar wrong this time as he hurls it wide outside off, Shafiq is not bothered to play at that one.
Wider outside off this time, Shafiq makes an easy leave.

THAT'S A PEACH! Angles in a length delivery from wider of the crease, Shafiq is squared up a bit and looks to defend it but is beaten by the sharp away movement. Perfect line and length to bowl on this track.
On a length shaping in, Shafiq camps back and plays it with an angled blade to point.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
In the channel outside off, left alone. Second maiden in a trot.

BRILLIANT EFFORT BY WADE! Searches for a yorker but ends up a bowling a low full toss well outside off, Ali looks to jam it out but gets an under edge towards the left of Wade. He moves briskly and leaps athletically in the air to make a goal keeper like save.
WELL BOWLED! Hurls it on a channel outside off, zips through the pitch after landing. Ali covers his off pole and lets it through.
Fullish delivery outside off angling away. Driven nicely to mid off.
Dug in short outside off, Azhar sways away from the line of the delivery.

ALI WAS IN A TANGLE THERE! Bowls it on a length on leg stump, Ali looks to tuck it but closes his bat face early and the ball catches him high on the bat. Lobs safely towards the short mid-wicket region.
MITCHELL STARC to bowl from the other end.
Fullish delivery outside off, swinging away. Shafiq points his bat skywards and lets it through. 8th maiden over for Hazlewood.
In the corridor of uncertainty, curving away after pitching as Asad watches it closely and lets it go through to the keeper.
On a length shaping back in. Shafiq camps back and defends it to the off side.
That one swung away appreciably! It was on a driving length outside off luring Asad into the drive but he resisted the temptation.
Fullish delivery wide outside off, Shafiq doesn't flirt with that one.
WELL BOWLED! Back of a length outside off, shapes away late after pitching. Shafiq is in two minds and looks to play at it initially but withdraws his bat at the last moment.

Welcome back for the final session after a long rain delay. The players and the umpires come out in the middle. AZHAR ALI and ASAD SHAFIQ will continue their innings. Will they continue to frustrate the Aussies and soldier on or will the home side bounce back hard? NEW BALL HAS ALSO BEEN TAKEN and JOSH HAZLEWOOD willl bowl first up. Here we go...
UPDATE 0945 IST - News is coming in that Tea has been taken. Play is set to resume at 1000 IST if there is no further rain interruption. Final 3 hour session is coming up.

UPDATE 0930 IST - The word is that the next inspection will take place at 0940 IST, 1510 local time. That time is also the time when tea is scheduled to be taken. Let's hope for better news this time 'round.

UPDATE 0915 IST - Still gloomy scenes from the MCG and the drizzle has settled into a steady mode. Covers are being put on the bowler's run up area as well. In a while, we will get news whether early tea would be taken or not. It has been a frustrating day for the cricketing fans so far. Let's hope we got some positive news soon.
UPDATE 0820 IST - Just minutes before the inspection, the rain increased a little and that has made the groundsmen bring the covers back on. The waiting game continues...
UPDATE 0810 IST - Some good news as the big cover is off. The one on the pitch still remains, though. There will be another inspection at 0820 IST.
UPDATE 0745 IST - More covers are coming on. The inspection which was supposed to happen hasn't. Looks like there will be further delay due to the drizzle. Stay tuned for further updates.

UPDATE 0735 IST - There will be an inspection at 0745 IST. We should have started the second session by now but the covers are still on. There is a bit of drizzle still around, hope the weather clears out soon. Stay tuned for further updates.
...DAY 2, SESSION 2...

The Australians have had a tough outing this morning. They tried everything they could, Smith made as many bowling changes and to add to it he brought himself into the attack as well but it was to no avail. The Pakistan batsmen have dealt with the pace attack nicely and have scored runs at will too. There are chances of rain as it is  pretty dark out there which is why Smith didn't take the second new ball as he had fear of it getting wet. We had a mini-halt in play in the first session and let's hope we get an uninterrupted day's play. Join us back in a short while to see what happens next...

A session which is completely bagged by Pakistan! They have seen off the session unscathed under the overcast conditions and that is some thing to take confidence from. The highlight of the session was Azhar Ali who has dug himself in well out there and in the process has also registered a much-deserved ton. Asad Shafiq at the other end has given ample support to the centurion and has shown the Aussies he is a force to be reckoned with.

Both the umpires have a chat between themselves and ask the players to head to their dressing rooms. Lunch is still 10 minutes away but since it has gone gloomy out there the umpires have called for AN EARLY LUNCH! The covers are hauled in too...
Lovely! Fuller and angling in on the pads, Shafiq gets across and flicks it past Starc at mid on. He goes for the chase but couldn't prevent three.
Keeps it full and comes back in a shade, Shafiq presses forward and blocks it down the track.
Gets right behind the line of the ball and defends.
Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, flicked towards fine leg for a single.
In the channel outside off, Ali leaves it alone.
Fuller in length and angling in, defended off the front foot.
JACKSON BIRD comes back for a bowl. The new ball is due now but it's still not been taken. The reviews are refreshed now.
Charge, oops straight to the man at mid off but.
Around off, turning in, Shafiq keeps it out with a solid defense.
AS has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around off, blocked.
100-run stand between Shafiq and Ali!

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Lyon is taken for runs here. Tossed up outside off, it's a bit short from around the wicket. Shafiq camps back and thwacks the punch through covers for another boundary.

FOUR! It's a ripper, it's a four! Lyon bowls a loopy ball outside off, Shafiq gets down and fetches it from outside off to sweep it through mid-wicket for a boundary. The fielder tries to stop it with a dive but fails to do so.
The ball has been swapped as it got wet.
NATHON LYON back into the attack.
Short and turning away, Shafiq gets back and cuts it wide of the fielder at backward point. Running is not an issue and they get three more.
Prods forward and keeps it out on the off side.
FOUR! You can't bowl him short, he will make you pay all day and night! Another long hop from Maddinson and he sees it getting pulled in front of square for a boundary all the way.
Shortish in length and around off, Asad defends it off the back foot.
An arm ball from around off, Shafiq hangs back in defense.
Full and angling in, defended by making a good stride forward.
Flighted ball around middle and off, tucked towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Nicely floated around off, Ali defends it off the front foot.
Gets forward and pushes it past the Aussie skipper for a single.
Full around off, eased down to long off for one.
Shafiq taps this delivery towards covers and scurries across for a quick single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! No one in the deep and Maddinson bowls a half-tracker and was asking for trouble. Ali camps back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short and outside off, AS gets back and punches it towards cover-point for a single.
Shortish in length, punched towards mid on for one.
Tossed up around off, driven straight to covers.
Tossed up around off, Shafiq makes a bit of room to drive it through the off side but gets an inside edge past the stumps towards fine leg for a single.
Flicked through the on side for a single.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
That's a ripper shouts an excited Bill Lawry on air. Smith pushes it quicker through the air and it zips in a touch, Ali does well to defend it down.
Drops it short, a customary delivery by every leg spinner. Shafiq camps back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shafiq presses forward and defends it down.
Fuller around middle, Shafiq jams it back to the bowler.
Full on the pads, flicked towards backward square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off.
AS has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full around off, driven through covers for a single.
12th Test ton for Azhar Ali, 3rd vs Australia!

AZHAR ALI GETS TO HIS TON! Such an impressive knock by this man. He played the patience game and then attacked when it was needed. Leaps a bit in the air, removes the helmet and has his hands aloft. The entire Pakistan team in the dressing room lauds the effort. Coming to the ball, around middle and leg, it's worked towards fine leg for a couple.
Loopy ball around off, Ali drives it past extra cover but he sees Warner coming from mid off and shouts NO.
Quicker through the air around off, Ali stays back and defends it off the back foot.
Now we have another change. NIC MADDINSON into the attack now.
Around middle and leg, nudged straight to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Full and going down leg, Ali clips it towards the leg side for a single. Moves to 99!
Floats it up around off, Ali makes a good stride forward, brings his bat and pad together to defend it down.
Flatter and shorter in length, Shafiq pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A loopy full toss around middle, flicked towards square leg for a single.
Short and around off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Surprise! Surprise! Captain STEVEN SMITH wants to have a go with the cherry now. Can he get a breakthrough?
Bird once again pitches it up on the stumps, Shafiq looks to drive but is not off the middle of the bat and it rolls towards mid on.
Fuller and pretty much outside off, Asad drives it straight to mid off.
Shafiq calls for an arm-guard...
Back of a length delivery in the channel outside off, Shafiq stays tall and taps it towards the off side.
Length ball on the hips, AA tucks it behind square on the leg side to get off the strike.
Fuller and tailing back in, Ali presses forward and pushes it with soft hands towards mid on.
Hurrah! We are back, folks! The drizzle has stopped and the covers come off. The players and the umpires are back in the middle. Ali will take strike and Bird will continue his over. Here we go...

Just at the start of the over, umpire S Ravi went towards the square leg umpire, Ian Gould, to have a word as it was drizzling. And now it is enough to ask the players to leave the field. The groundsmen rush in to cover the square. It isn't much at the moment and let's hope we get back in quickly...
Back of a length ball outside off, Ali hops across and tucks it towards mid-wicket.

Loopy around middle and leg, Asad comes down the track and works it straight to the man at short mid-wicket. The fielder returns a throw at the striker's end and it hits but Shafiq's bat was grounded.
Tosses it up around off, Shafiq presses forward in defense.
Ali shuffles a bit and tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Shafiq camps back and punches it through the gap at covers. Bird does well in the deep to keep them down to three.
Worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flatter and short around middle and leg, flicked through square leg by Shafiq. He wanted another one as well but Ali is happy with one.
Angles away on a length outside off, Ali drops his wrists and lets it go.
Very full and outside off, Ali somehow manages to dig it out down the track.
Good length ball, angling in, defended back to Bird.
Good stop, Khawaja! Fuller in length and around off, Azhar gets forward and looks to drive it through covers. Khawaja stationed there dives full length to his left to stop some runs for his side.
Ali stays behind the line and shows a straight bat.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up on the stumps, Shafiq looks to defend but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards short leg.
Tossed up around off, Shafiq makes a good stride forward and drives it towards mid off.
Comes down the track and flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, Ali comes forward and drives it towards deep mid on for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, flicked past short leg.
Around off, turning in, flicked off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
Time for Drinks.

A BIT OF A BLIP BY THE TV UMPIRE! Bowls a fullish ball that tails back in, Shafiq comes forward and drives it towards Bird who manages to get a hand on it. Deflects it towards the non-striker's stumps and hits it. Azhar Ali dived in to get back. Is he in? The run out appeal is referred upstairs. Ali did brilliantly there to dive back into his crease. Ooh. wait! The TV umpire has ruled it OUT on the big screen by mistake. The crowd bursts into a loud cheer but it is quickly changed into NOT OUT. The huge cheer soon turns into boos.
On a length outside off, Shafiq is again caught in his crease as he inside edges it onto his pads. Good back to back deliveries from Bird.

WASTE OF A REVIEW! On a length and angling back sharply. Shafiq is tentative in his foot work as he looks to block it but seems to have missed it as the ball brushes something and carries through to Wade. There is a loud appeal for a catch but the umpire shakes his head. Wade is not sure and so is Smith but he opts to take the review. The replays show that it brushed the thigh pad. The snicko also doesn't spot any edge there. The on-field call stays!
Australia have taken a review against Asad Shafiq. It is for a caught behind appeal.
Fuller length ball this time, pushed off the front foot to mid on.
Short of a length wide outside off, Shafiq slashes at it hard. Perhaps a risk free shot as he gave it his all.
On a length angling back in. He puts his head down and defends calmly.
Gives this one plenty of air and bowls it on off, Ali prods forward in defense.
Shortish outside off, Shafiq rocks back and punches it through the off side for a run. Good footwork there!
Azhar plays it with the spin to the leg side for a run.
FOUR! SHOT! Ali kneels down to the loopy delivery and sweeps it hard round the corner. He hit it really well and gets the desired result. Moves into the nineties. He is growing in confidence!
Fullish delivery on off, defended off the front foot to short mid-wicket.
Fetches this from around off and sweeps it to fine leg. Single taken!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
That's a brave leave! Bowls it on a length just outside off, shapes back in a touch. Ali covers his off pole and the ball zips through to the keeper.
50-run stand up between Ali and Shafiq.

FOUR! Shot of the morning! Bowls a fullish delivery outside off, Ali lunges forward confidently and drives it down the ground. The timing is of the highest quality and the ball races to the fence. Moves to 88.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
That's a loose shot! Bowls a shortish delivery wide outside off, Azhar slashes at it hard but misses. Perhaps a lapse in concentration. He needs to play a big one for the visitors.
Length delivery around off, defended to the leg side.
This time he plays it a bit finer to the same region and completes a brisk single this time.
A bit short this time, Ali wait for it and turns it to short fine leg. Looks for the single but won't get it.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to mid on off the front foot.
Asad clips it with the spin to the leg side for a run.
That was a very optimistic shout! Shafiq advances down the track and looks to play it with the spin but misses it and is rapped on the pads. It would have been going down leg!
Quicker one spinning into the stumps, defended solidly off the back foot to short leg.
On a length on leg stump, Azhar shuffled there and plays it towards square leg.
Fuller length ball angling in, Azhar covers the line and defends it to mid on.
Comes forward and pushes it off the front foot to mid on.
Bowls a fullish delivery, Ali defends it towards mid-wicket.

Good shot! Bowls it fullish outside off, Shafiq leans ahead and creams it through the covers. Lyon sprints after it and puts in a slide at deep cover. Keeps it down to three and the crowd is right behind him. It must be a great feeling to have so many passionate people cheering for you.
On a length around off, Shafiq prods forward and defends it to the off side.
Fullish ball on the stumps, clipped with the spin through mid-wicket for an easy single.
Loopy ball outside off, Shafiq puts his head down and defends it down the track calmly.
Tossed up around off, driven to mid off.
Ali comes forward to the loopy ball and works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Spinning into Asad. He helps it past short leg for a run.
Gives it a lot of air outside off, Shafiq drives it towards mid off.
NATHAN LYON to bowl now. Can he strike?
Length delivery outside off, Azhar hangs back and defends it to the covers. Maiden for Bird to start with!
Fullish ball angling in, Ali lunges forward and blocks it down on the track.
Similar length ball outside off, Azhar lunges forward confidently and pushes it to Khawaja at short cover. He is looking good for a century.
Full length ball outside off, driven firmly to mid off.
Shortish delivery wide outside off, Azhar cuts it to Lyon at point. The crowd cheers up for him. He is also warming up. Might be in with a spell soon.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
JACKSON BIRD is into the attack.
On a length outside off, Shafiq taps it towards gully for nothing.
Bowls a bouncer on middle, Ali ducks under it and evades the bumper.
Straying on the pads, nudged to fine leg for a single.
Slips this one down the leg side, Azhar looks to clip it but misses.
Length delivery outside off, curls in a shade. Ali stays back and lets it through. Warner is looking to shine one end of the ball. The rain last night is not helping the cause.
On a length on off, Azhar defends it off his back foot to the man at short mid-wicket. Calls a loud no to his non-striker.
Length delivery outside off, Shafiq hangs back and defends it to the off side.
Fuller length ball shaping back in, Azhar comes forward and check drives it down the ground. Gets it past Bird at mid on. Three runs taken!
Short of a length ball attacking the body, Azhar is surprised by it but does well in the end to tuck it round the corner. Single taken!
Length delivery outside off, Azhar taps it with soft hands towards point and scurries through for a brisk single. Excellent running!
Fuller length ball outside off, pushed off the front foot to the covers.
Length delivery on off, Shafiq defends it towards Maddinson at short leg who makes a good reflex stop.
Fullish delivery angling in, Asad clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

Good match awareness! Short of a length ball, Ali hangs back and looks to tuck it but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards the right side of the pitch. Maddinson comes sprinting in but the batsmen complete the run in a flash.
Ali covers the line to the length delivery and pushes it to mid off.
Fuller length ball outside off, Ali strides forward and blocks it.
Camps back to the back of a length ball and plays it to point.
Silly mid on in place now.
On a length angling into Asad. Looks to find the gap between his bat and pad but Asad comes forward and defends it.
Digs it short around leg stump this time, Shafiq ducks underneath it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Invites him to drive again and bowls it outside off, Shafiq resists the temptation and lets it go this time. Starc has a look at him and smiles. Shafiq nods his head and acknowledges the delivery.
On a driving length outside off, Shafiq is drawn into a full blooded drive but gets beaten. This is good Test match stuff!
Fullish delivery angling in on off, Shafiq comes forward, open his bat face and plays it towards point.
Length delivery outside off, Ali hangs back and defends it towards point. A maiden by Hazlewood.
Hurls it wide outside off this time, Ali doesn't bother to play at that one.
Bowls a short delivery around leg stump, Azhar ducks under it.
On a length around off, Ali strides forward and defends it back towards the bowler.
Back of a length ball angling in sharply, Azhar is caught in the crease as he looks to tuck it but misses and is struck on the thigh pad. Hazlewood is probing around here.
On a length outside off, holds its line. Asad points his bat skywards and allows it through.
Fuller length ball outside off, Asad looks to drive it hard but gets an outside edge that falls in front of the man at cover-point.
Bowls a very full ball at 143.8 clicks outside off, Shafiq jams it out down the track.
Dug in short outside off, angling in. Shafiq arches back and sways away from the line to evade it.
Hurls this one wider outside off, Shafiq doesn't flirt with it.
Fullish delivery angling in, Asad comes forward and defends it.
Comes around the wicket and hurls in a length delivery outside off, holds its line. Shafiq lets it go.
Fuller length ball attacking the stumps, Ali clips it through mid-wicket and gets a couple to his name.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ali lunges forward and defends it confidently.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.

Short of a length ball angling into Ali. He moves across and looks to clip it but is struck on the thigh pad. A stifled appeal for LBW was made but the Aussies pulled out of it. It was going down leg.
Fullish delivery just outside off, Ali puts his head down and defends it down the track.
On a length angling into Ali. He hangs back and defends it to short mid-wicket.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Dug in short outside off, Shafiq arches back and lets it sail through to the keeper.
Mid on comes to slip.
Straying on the hips, tucked round the corner for a run.
Shortish delivery into the stumps this time, Azhar tucks it to the man at square leg.

A bit straighter on this occasion, Ali drives it nicely through the covers. This time Warner chases it with spring in his stride and keeps it down to a couple. He is a great athlete. Bill Lawry on air reckons, 'The wicket has quickened up this morning. There is good carry.'
Excellent running between the wickets! Fuller length ball well outside off, Shafiq extends his arms and caresses it through the covers. Warner sprints after it but the batsmen come back for three.
Tests him with the short ball on middle and leg, angling down. Azhar ducks under the bumper.
Goes a bit wider of the crease and angles in a fullish delivery, Ali lunges forward and drives it to mid off
In the channel outside off, holds its line after pitching. Left alone.
Short of a length ball outside off, Shafiq hangs back and plays it with an angled blade through gully. Good running between the wicket allows them to come back for three.
Back of a length outside off and hits the deck hard. Shafiq points his bat skywards and allows it through safely. Great carry on that one!
On a length on middle, Shafiq tucks it to the leg side.
Bowls a short one outside off angling across Azhar. He sways away from the line of the delivery.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Bowls a fuller length ball outside off, Ali leans forward and times his drive beautifully down the ground and the ball whistles away to the fence. That was delightful to watch!
Fullish ball outside off, driven to mid off.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Ali puts his head down and defends it nicely.
Fuller length ball outside off, angling away. Ali is drawn into the drive but gets it off the inner half back towards the bowler.
Fullish delivery angling across Ali. He doesn't flirt with that one.
MITCHELL STARC comes into the attack. Three slips, gully and a point in place.
In the channel outside off, Shafiq doesn't flirt with it. A good steady maiden over by Hazlewood.

On a length shaping back into the stump, Asad hangs back and defends it towards mid on. Shane Warne on air mentions, that the Pakistani batsmen haven't kept the scoreboard ticking. They have allowed the Australian bowlers to dictate terms.
In the corridor of uncertainty, third leave of the over.
Good carry on that one! Fullish delivery outside off, zips through the pitch as Asad lets it go through.
Length delivery angling in to Shafiq. He camps back and defends it stoutly.
In the channel outside off, Shafiq points his bat skywards and lets it through.
HAZLEWOOD to bowl from the other end.
On a length outside off, holding its line. Ali makes a watchful leave.

We are all set to get underway. The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. AZHAR ALI and ASAD SHAFIQ to continue from where they left off. JACKSON BIRD to finish his pending over. Let's play...

Though it is a pretty good track to bat on, the overcast conditions have made it a stern test for the batsmen. Only Azhar Ali has looked composed in the middle and he would need to play a big one to steer the visitors to safe harbours. On the other hand, the home side would look to keep on nipping away at the wickets and keep them under the lid. Will the tourists put up a brave fight and put up a decent score on the board? Let's see who comes out on top.

Hello and a warm welcome for Day 2 of the second Test between Australia and Pakistan. We lost almost 40 overs yesterday and let's hope that the weather gods stay merciful and we get the extended allotted quota of overs for today. Australia have begun well and would look to stamp their authority further with the ball. Hazlewood and Bird have bowled brilliant lines and lengths and have reaped the rewards. The latter deserves a special mention as he has continued to put relentless pressure on the Pakistanis with his immaculate channel outside off.
...DAY 2, SESSION 1...

Pakistan would be pinning their hopes on the current pair to add as many possible so that they can post a good total on the board on what is an extremely a good batting surface. While the Aussies would be itching to go out and continue from where they left off today,  their pacers bowled some tight lines and have reaped dividends for the same. Just a reminder - There will be an early start tomorrow at 0430 IST to cover up for the overs lost today. The forecast for the remaining days isn't pleasing and we can only keep our fingers crossed and hope it stays away. Let's see how day 2 unfolds. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Take care. Cheers!

A sorry end to an opening day of Boxing Day Test. Final session has been completely washed out which means we have lost almost 40 overs, many more events could have happened had the rain not interrupted. The Test is poised perfectly at the moment but the home side slightly has an upper hand as Jackson Bird removed both the veterans Younis Khan and Misbah before the rain gods appeared. However, Azhar Ali has kept hold at one end and is unbeaten on 66. He has Asad Shafiq, the star of the previous Test for company followed by Sarfraz Ahmed.
UPDATE 1118 IST - The inevitable has happened and rain has had its final say as the umpires have DECIDED TO CALL IT A DAY.
UPDATE 1105 IST - It's still raining at the MCG and chances of having any more play today looks bleak. We will keep you posted with further updates.
UPDATE 1000 IST - The tea break has passed but it is still raining at the MCG. Let's hope the showers stop and we get some play soon.
...DAY 1, SESSION 3...

Ali is holding one end up and he will need support from Shafiq, who was the star for Pakistan in the first Test. Can both of them bail the visitors out of trouble or will the Aussies keep on nipping wickets and push them further into a hole? Let's hope the weather clears out and we get to witness some exciting cricket in the final session.

Australia's session again as they have nipped out two huge wickets of Younis and Misbah. The duo never looked comfortable at the crease as Bird and Starc swung the ball around in overcast conditions. The former has been terrific after lunch and he has reaped rewards for bending his back and bowling his heart out. These are testing conditions to bat on and Azhar Ali has been the only one who has battled it out and has played a fighting knock so far.
There was a slight drizzle in the air and now it has picked up. The umpires have made a sensible call and have taken an EARLY TEA as the covers are rushed on to the ground.
Back of a length ball around off, Ali camps back and tucks it towards mid on.
Back of a length ball outside off, left alone.
Fuller length ball tailing in, clipped to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Too straight and full on this ocassion, Azhar is well balanced as he clips it beautifully through mid-wicket. Timed that really well and the ball whistles to the fence.
FOUR! Short of a length outside off, Ali pokes at it but gets a thick outside edge past the slip cordon and the ball races to the fence. Bird has his tail up and is really bending his back.
FOUR! SHOT! Bowls a back of  a length ball outside off, Shafiq rises with the bounce and upper cuts it over gully. Good shot and he gets a boundary to his name.
Camps back to the length delivery on off and defends it to the left of Starc.
Length delivery angling across Asad. he feels for it and is beaten all ends up. Good channel from Starc.
On a length angling across Shafiq. he points his bat skywards and lets it go.
Fuller length ball on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Shafiq puts his head down and defends it down the track calmly.
STARC is back into the attack.
On a length outside off, Azhar leans forward and plays it with an angled blade to the off side.
Fullish delivery tailing into the stumps, driven nicely to mid on for nothing.
FOUR! LUCKY RUNS! Back of a length around off, Azhar shuffles and goes back to defend it but gets a thick outside edge past the slip cordon and races to the fence.
Camp back to the length delivery and defends it to the off side solidly.
Shortish delivery into the stumps, Ali hops back and keeps it down on the track.
Length delivery around off, defended off the front foot solidly.
Quicker one, defended nicely off the back foot to short leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shafiq comes forward and helps it with the spin to backward square leg.
Gets forward and blocks this one.
Gets right behind this one and defends it.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
ASAD SHAFIQ walks out to bat.

OUT! THE SKIPPER DEPARTS! The floodgates have opened! Fullish delivery around off, shaping in a touch. Misbah comes forward half-heartedly and looks to defend it but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball lobs towards Maddinson at short leg and he bends low to his left to take a sharp reflex catch. The umpires consult with each other and refer it upstairs. The soft signal is out. Has Maddinson taken it cleanly? Time for the replays. They show that Maddinson has taken it cleanly. That's a brilliant catch and the TV umpire rules it out. Pakistan are stuttering at 125/4.
Misbah has been caught at short leg by Nic Maddinson. The umpire refers it upstairs to check whether he has been caught cleanly or not. The soft signal is out.
Fullish delivery outside off, Misbah comes forward and defends it down the track.
Stays back to the similar length delivery and defends it towards cover-point.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Short of a length ball outside off, Misbah camps back and looks to play it with an angled bat gets an outside edge in between slips and gully and the ball races to the third man fence.
Short of a length ball angling into Misbah. He rides the bounce and defends it in front of short leg.
Comes forward and blocks it with the spin into the ground.
Shortish delivery, Ali camps back and defends.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Comes down the track and defends it to towards mid on.
Tossed up delivery, Ali comes forward and pushes it back towards the bowler.
Ali camps back and works it to the leg side with the spin.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, clipped behind squae leg for a run.
Comes forward to the fullish delivery and plays it with an angled bat towards point.
Bowls a short of a length ball on middle and leg, Azhar looks to tuck it but is rapped on the thigh pad.
Overpitched outside off, driven firmly to the man at covers.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ali makes a watchful leave.
Fullish delivery outside off, shaping back in. Ali is tentative as he gets an inside edge onto his pads. Great channel from Bird!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shortish outside off, punched through covers for a run.
Misbah sweeps this one towards square leg but fails to find the gap.

SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Tosses it outside off, Misbah kneels and slog sweeps it over deep mid-wicket. That made a really cracking sound of the bat! The umpires check whether its' a boundary or maximum and the replays show that it has crossed the ropes.
Goes back in his crease and works it with the spin through backward square leg for a run.
Bowls it shortish around leg stump, Ali closes his bat face early as he looks to work it but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Bird is bowling beautifully! Bowls a short of a length ball outside off, Misbah hops back to defend but gets an edge towards the slip region. A wicket maiden from Bird.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Well bowled! Bowls it fullish outside off, swinging back. Misbah comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge towards the slip region.
Bowls a back of a length ball shaping back in. Misbah looks to clip it but is rapped on the thigh pad. Stifled appeal for LBW turned down.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to the covers to Warner. He has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Misbah-Ul-Haq is the next man in.

OUT! GREAT BOWLING FROM BIRD! Bowls a fullish delivery outside off, talis back in just a shade. Khan is tentative as he looks to block it out but the ball passes between the gate of his bat and pad and crashes into the stumps. Bird is elated and Khan's uncomfortable stay at the crease comes to an end. It's a big, big wicket for the Aussies. Can they trigger a collapse now?
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Khan leans ahead and drives it with the spin towards mid on for a single.
Prods forward to this one and defends it.
24th Test Fifty up for Azhar Ali.
Ali plays it with the spin through mid-wicket and takes a single. It has been a composed knock and he needs to convert it into a big one.
Stays back and defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Shortish delivery on the stumps, worked to short fine leg.
Gets on the front and drives it firmly but finds Khawaja at extra cover.
Khan doesn't fiddle with the delivery outside off this time.
Fuller in length and on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.

FOUR! Exquisitve! Fuller in length and around off, it was in his slot. He comes forward a bit, shows a full face of the bat and drills it through extra cover. The ball races away to the fence for a gorgeous-looking boundary.
Very full outside off, driven straight to the man at short extra cover.
Fuller in length and outside off, YK shoulders his arms to that one.
Drinks break!
Makes a good stride forward and pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Short and turning in, Khan goes back and cuts it towards point.
Full and around off, defended off the front foot.
Ali milks it down to long on for a single.

Good fielding, Josh! Tossed up outside off, Younis makes a good stride forward and drives it through extra cover. Hazlewood gives it a chase and does well to scoop the ball back in play. They check it upstairs if his legs made contact with the rope when he had the ball in his hands. He didn't, three taken.
Loopy ball around middle, driven towards mid on for a single.
Very full and wide outside off, driven through covers for a couple.
Defended off the back foot towards covers.
Good length delivery on middle, YK hops, has his one leg up and chops it towards point.
A shout for LBW! On a length and angling in, Khan is beaten by the inward movement and is hit on the thigh pad. Bird appeals for LBW but the umpire's turns it down. The height was an issue there.
Good shot! Fuller in length and outside off, Ali comes forward and caresses it past Warner at mid off who gives it a chase and does well to keep them down to three.
Fuller in length and angling in, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Loops it up around middle and leg, Khan flicks it a bit uppishly towards short mid-wicket for a single.
Gets forward and defends it down watchfully.
Ali drives it towards long on for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, flicked towards the leg side.
On middle and leg, flicked towards short fine leg for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, Younis gets across and forward to flick it towards mid-wicket.
NATHAN LYON is brought back into the attack!
Fuller in length and on off, defended down gently.
Good length on off, punched through covers for a single.
YK lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Lyon takes a crowd catch! Fuller in length and outside off, Younis leans into it and drives it on the up towards Lyon at point who takes it.
Gets across and works it towards mid-wicket.
Goes back and punches it towards the square of the wicket on the off side.
Ali bunts it back to the bowler who tries to stop it with his right hand but fails to make it cleanly.
Fuller on middle and leg, defended on the leg side.
Miscued! Fuller in length and angling in, Ali tries to drive but ends up playing it a bit too early. He chips it and can consider himself lucky as the ball falls well short of Warner at mid off.
Leg bye! Fuller and angling in, Khan once again shuffles across to flick but misses to get any wood on it. The ball brushes his pads and rolls towards the leg side. A leg bye taken.
On a good length and around middle, Khan stays behind the line to defend it down.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
In the channel outside off, double A makes another leave to the keeper.
Fuller on off, it's left alone.
Short and similar to the last ball, Khan rides the bounce as he pierces the gap through point and gully. They pick up another three.
Lovely stop! Short and a little bit of width on offer, Khan cuts it towards point where Lyon dives full length to his left to stop a certain boundary.
Fuller in length and wide outside off, Ali gets forward and drives it through covers and gets back for the third.
FOUR! Just a flick of the wrists! This is the first boundary for Ali! Bird angles in a full length delivery on the pads, Ali gets across a touch and just flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Angles in a length delivery from outside off, Khan tries to defend but is beaten and is hit on the thigh pad.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked straight to mid on.
Beaten! Fuller in length and served outside off, YK looks to drive but without any foot movement he nearly ends up nicking one behind.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, driven with a straight bat towards mid on.
Digs it short and down the leg side, Ali tries to pull but fails to get going with the shot.
Younis isn't forward nor backward so does well to defend it off the soft hands back to the bowler.
YK gets across to tuck it but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball dies down.
Fuller in length and angling in, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Gets forward and defends it off the front foot gently.
Good length delivery outside off, Khan defends it towards the off side.
Bird angles it in and sprays on the pads, Ali clips it through mid-wicket and some good running between the wickets allows them to come back for the third.
JACKSON BIRD is back into the attack now!
Khan chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length and just outside off, YK shoulders his arms.

NOT OUT! Excellent use of the review by the veteran here! The decision has to be overturned! Hazlewood angles in a length delivery on middle, Younis shuffles far to across to flick it down the leg side but is completely beaten and is hit on the pads. Josh turns back to appeal for an LBW and the umpire raises his finger. It looked plumb to the naked eye but Younis opts for the review. Replays show it was in line and would have gone on to miss the stumps. Oooos and Ahhss around the stadium and the Aussie players have their hands on their heads.
Younis Khan is adjudged LBW and it looks plumb to the naked eye. He opts for the review. Let's wait and see.
Presses forward and shows a straight bat to bunt it back to Josh.
Angles it on the pads, clipped towards fine leg for an easy single.
Fuller in length and slants it across the batsman, Khan has got nothing to offer on that one.
Back of a length ball on off, Ali stands tall, fends it towards covers and scurries across for a brisk single.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Good length ball on off, Ali gets across and tucks it towards the leg side.
On a length and outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Back of a length ball on middle, Ali covers the line and defends it down the track.
