Fuller in length on off, Younis comes forward, lifts his bat and keeps Wade busy.
Pitches it up this time on off, punched down the track as the man from mid on comes to his left to stop that one.
Good length delivery outside off, defended off the back foot to the off side.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Younis stands tall and defends it off the front foot solidly.
Fuller on the pads, clipped through mid-wicket again and this time he gets it past the fielder for one.
Ali gets across and works it through mid-wicket for nothing.
Hits the deck hard again on middle, the batsman bends down to let it go over him to the keeper.
On a length and some bounce as well, it's just outside off. YK lifts his bat and makes another good leave.
Fuller in length and coming in from outside off. Khan comes forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Angles in a length delivery, moving away from the batsman. He is happy to stay inside the line and let it go again.
Now he keeps it short on off, YK arches back to let it go over him to Wade.
Well bowled! Starc is right on the money! He fires in a very full delivery, coming back in sharply. Younis Khan does well to jam it out on the off side.
Length delivery hurled in the channel on off, AA makes a leave to the keeper.
Leg bye! Hazlewood tries to be a bit more straight and ends up spraying it on the pads, Khan tries to clip it but gets it off the pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
Good length ball on off, tapped in front of covers for a single.
Fuller in length again and angling in, Ali gets across and defends it towards the leg side.
Fuller and strayed on the pads, YK flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Younis Khan is off the mark! Back of a length ball outside off, Khan punches it through point and comes back for a double.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
4 Byes! Bowls it shortish outside leg, keeps angling down leg. Wade dives to his left full length but fails to stop it. Races to the fence and four byes signaled by the umpire.
Well directed bouncer! Dug in short around off at 140.4 clicks, Ali has to sway away from the line to evade it.
Straying on the hips this time, Azhar nudges it round the corner for a couple.
Short delivery outside off, Ali lets it go.
Back of a length delivery, Ali camps back and defends it.
We are back for the second session. Starc will start the proceedings after lunch. Younis Khan joins Azhar Ali in the middle. Here we go...
...DAY 1, SESSION 2...

Join us in a bit for the post-lunch session as it is surely going to be an interesting one. It's gloomy out there, the lights have been turned on and one can expect the ball to move around. Let's see what do we have in store next. Don't go anywhere as we will be right back at 0740 IST...

Babar Azam and Azhar Ali then steadied the ship and almost saw off the session before the former fell prey to Hazlewood just at the stroke of lunch. He bowled probing lines and lengths since the start and finally has something to show in the wicket column. Azhar Ali is still out there and will have the hero of the first Test, Asad Shafiq for company next. Can the duo make the most of the toss and a good batting surface in the next session? Or will the Aussie bowlers chip in with wickets regularly?

A perfect session for the home side as they have begun the Boxing Day Test on the right note. They lost the toss but will be happy to sneak in a couple of wickets. It is a good batting surface and the Pakistan openers braved well to see off the new ball. You got to give it to Smith who handed over the cherry to Nathan Lyon very early in the innings and he didn't let his skipper down. He removed Aslam in his very first over and got the crowd right behind him.

OUT! Edged and taken! Steven Smith once again is in the picture but credit to Hazlewood here. He kept on luring the batsmen to go after him and finally reaps the dividends. Hurls a length delivery on off, moves away a shade. Azam thinking it's the last ball before lunch goes after it to defend and sees the ball catching the outside edge of his willow. It flies towards the Aussie skipper at second slip who dives to his right to pluck it inches above the ground. Josh Hazlewood is delighted as the players walk back. LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Short of a length ball on middle, Azam covers the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Back of a length ball on off, Azam waits for it to come on the bat and dabs it towards gully. Fails to beat the man there who dives to his left to stop that one.
Overpitched on off, Ali drives it past covers. Once again the fielder gives it a chase and keeps them down to three.

There are too many flies buzzing around the grill of Ali's helmet. Josh Hazlewood comes running and delivers the ball only to see he's being pulled off at the last moment as Azhar was distracted by the flies. Poor bowler has to go back and the look on his face says it all.
In the channel outside off, Ali lifts his bat and lets it go through to the keeper.
Fuller and strayed on the pads, it's flicked towards square leg where the fielder dives to his right to stop that one.
Sharp bumper from Mitchell Starc. Babar Azam arches back a bit and watches as the ball whizzes past his helmet.
Aimed at the hips, it's glanced down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery coming in to the body, it's blocked.
Leg slip in place now too...

Superman-like dive from Matthew Wade! It's banged in short and going down leg, way down leg and the ball seems like it will run away to the fence. But Matthew Wade dives a full stretch to his left and somehow catches the ball. Brilliant effort.
A forward short leg is in place now...
Much tighter from Mitchell and it's speared in on a full length, Babar Azam drives it back down the ground. The timing on that wasn't perfect but it's enough to get him three runs.
Starc comes charging in and fires across a length delivery, Babar Azam plants his front foot across and makes a watchful leave.
On a good length and just around the off stump, it's hit back down the track off the back foot. That'll be the end of the over.

Fires this right up there, once again there's some swing into the batsman. Azhar Ali strides forward and drives it straight back in Hazlewood's direction. The big pacer does well to bend low and get his right hand on it.
A bit of inswing on that occasion, it's worked away on the on side with gentle hands.
Banged in short on middle and leg, ducked and evaded.
Good line from Josh Hazlewood, in the channel outside off, Azhar Ali leaves it alone.
Angling in sharply on middle and leg, Azhar Ali looks to flick it across the line but is caught high on the pads instead.
The lights are turned on as it has gone dark out there...
Shortish in length on off, Babar hops and defends it away on the off side.
Too wide and outside off, Azam doesn't have a go at it.
Fuller in length and outside off, Azam slices this one through covers. It's not off the middle of the bat but will get two.
Good length wide outside off, pleasing Azam to go after it but he shows some patience and lets it go through.

FOUR! Deliberately done! Starc angles it away outside off, Azam stays in the crease, allows it to come on the bat, opens the face and steers it past a diving gully fielder for a boundary towards third man.
Risky running! Fuller and angling away, Ali taps it in front of covers and calls for a quick single. Azam responds late as there is a shy at the striker's end but Babar makes it in time.
On a good length and around off, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, BA doesn't fiddle with it.
Flicked through the leg side for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
In the channel outside off, Azhar shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in length and outside off, pushed straight to the man at mid off.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD is back into the attack!
Length delivery on middle, BA defends it down.

That took off! Starc comes running in and dishes out a short ball outside off, it shoots off the deck as Azam arches back to let it go. Wade behind the stumps leaps as much as he could and collects it well over his head.
Back of a length ball on off, Babar once again defends it with a straight blade.
Good length delivery on middle, Azam stays behind the line and defends it down.
On middle and leg, worked towards the on side for nothing.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Loopy ball around off, Ali pushes it towards covers and calls for a quick single.
More runs! Short and flat around off, Azam camps back and punches it through covers. The ground is too big as the batsmen get three.
FOUR! Lovely use of the feet! Tosses it up around middle, Azam wears his skates, gets close to the pitch of the ball and goes over mid on. Clears the man easily and finds the fence as well.
Around middle and leg, turned towards short leg.
Flatter and short around off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Lets out another length ball outside off, Babar is happy to leave it for Wade.
Good length ball, it's curling back in sharply as Azam is beaten completely here. He fails to defend and is hit on the thigh pad.
Short of a length ball on off, Azam once again hops and punches it towards point.
Back of a length on middle, Azam hops and fends it on the leg side.
Almost chops it! Angles in a length ball from outside off, Ali looks to defend it down but gets a thick inside edge just past the leg pole towards fine leg for a single.
Comes from over the wicket and hurls a length ball across the batsman. Ali watches it till the last moment and then leaves it alone.
MITCHELL STARC is back into the attack, replacing Bird.
Comes forward a bit and pushes it towards mid off.
Fuller around off, blocked out well.

In the air... safe! Lyon sees Azam coming down the track and hence bowls a quicker one around middle, Azam who is down the track is a bit cramped for room and as a result gets it off the inner part of the bat and is lucky as the ball falls safely in front of Handscomb at short leg.
Ali comes down the track and flicks it through mid on for a single.
Full and around off, Azhar defends it back to the bowler.
Drifting in around middle and leg, clipped towards fine leg for an easy couple.
Back of a length ball outside off, Azam punches it straight to Lyon at point.
Superb bowling! Fuller in length and moves away a touch, Azam looks to drive but gets beaten as the ball goes just past the outside edge to the keeper.
Shortish outside off, Azam sways away from the line to let it be.
Length delivery outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! Sweet! Fuller in length and pitched up on off, Azam comes a bit forward and nails the drive through wide mid off. It rocketed towards the fence before I could blink my eye.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Babar covers the line and defends it down.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Ali flicks it in front of FSL.
Tossed up delivery around middle and leg, Ali covers the line and tucks it towards the leg side.
Quicker around middle and off, skidding through, Ali goes back and pushes it towards covers.
Around middle and leg, flicked straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, spinning in, Ali comes down the track to flick but is beaten by the turn and is hit on the pads.
Flatter around middle and leg, Ali gets across and flicks it with soft hand towards fine leg for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Stays behind the line and taps it towards covers.
Fuller and angling in, Ali gets across and closes the face of the bat a bit too early. Gets a safe leading edge towards Warner at covers. A single is taken.
In the channel outside off, double A leaves it alone.
Good length ball on middle and off, defended with a straight bat.
Angles it down the leg side, Ali looks to flick but misses.
Full around off, pushed back to Lyon.
Darts it around middle and leg, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.

Edged away! Lyon loops it up around off, it straightens a bit after pitching. Azam prods forward, playing for the turn which isn't there. Gets a thick outside edge past Smith at first slip towards third man. Bird in the deep puts in a dive but the batsmen complete three runs till then.
Sees the flight and Ali once again comes down the track to clip it towards mid on for a quick single.
Tosses it up on off, Ali comes down the track and drives it firmly back to the bowler.
Loopy ball around off, Ali presses forward and defends.

Drinks are on the field. Pakistan did manage to see off the first hour but Smith handed over the cherry to the offie, Nathan Lyon who struck in his very first over. It's a good batting surface and let's wait and see if the visitors make the most of it in the next hour. They have to be a bit careful against Lyon though.
Fuller and around off, zipping in sharply as Azam looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge on the pads. Bird spots it and hence doesn't go up in an appeal.

Top edge but safe! Bird bangs in a short ball on middle, Ali swivels a bit as he looks to pull. Seems to have misread the length and ends up getting a top edge towards mid-wicket. The fielder runs towards the ball but it falls safely. A single taken but Ali would have his heart in his mouth.
Fullish in length and outside off, Ali opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards point.
Comes forward and slices it between point and gully. But couldn't get the single.
Touch fuller and outside off, Ali defend sit down watchfully.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven with soft hands towards short extra cover.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Gets across and defends it towards short leg.
BABAR AZAM is the next man in, replacing Aslam!

OUT! Nathan Lyon draws first blood. He has provided the breakthrough his skipper wanted him to. Lyon serves a loopy ball around off, turns away a touch. Sami Aslam presses forward to defend but the ball bounces a bit more than he anticipated, takes some part of the glove and pops up towards first slip where Smith takes a dolly. He throws the ball skywards and everyone is over Lyon here. The crowd was right behind the offie and he has delivered in his very first over.
Loopy ball around off, turning in, Ali flicks it through fine leg for a single. The crowd is right behind Nathan Lyon here.
Floats it up around middle and leg, Aslam comes forward and works it past short leg to get off the strike.
Here comes another bowling change, NATHAN LYON to roll his arm now. He has a short leg and a slip in place.
Length delivery outside off, AA stays inside the line to let it go through to the keeper.
Touch fuller and around off, the batsman lifts his bat to make another leave.
Azhar defends it from within the crease.
Covers the line and answers it with a straight bat.
On a length and in the corridor outside off, Ali has got nothing to do with that one.
Nathan Lyon is seen warming up... Early spin at the MCG coming up?
Stays behind the line and taps it towards point.
Good length delivery on off, the southpaw taps it in front of point and once again won't be allowed to take the single.
Fuller and angles it in on middle, Aslam prods forward and defends it towards covers. The bottom hand comes off in the process as well. He wanted a single but Lyon is quick to deny him that.
Back of a length ball outside off, Sami arches back to let it go.
Outside off, Sami doesn't feel for it.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, Aslam thinks about going after it but then changes his mind as he drops his wrists down and lets it go.
Too full and too wide outside off to make Ali play at it.
Touch fuller and around off, defended towards Lyon at point who moves quickly to his right to stop it.
Fuller in the channel outside off, Azhar lets it go.
AA defends it from within the crease.
Gets on the front foot and defends it down towards covers.
Fuller and angling in, worked towards mid on for a single.

Chance of a run out! Fuller in length and outside off, Aslam prods forward and taps it towards point. Lyon comes running in, picks up the ball and makes an underarm throw at the striker's end. Ali puts in a dive and even that wouldn't have been enough had the ball hit the stumps. He survives here as it goes well over the stumps. Risky running but gets the single in the end.
Comes from around the wicket now and angles it on the pads, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Very full and outside off, the batsman comes forward and decides to let that one go.
Dishes out a sharp bouncer, Sami Aslam ducks to let that one sail over him to the keeper.
Comes on the front foot and blocks it out solidly.
Good length delivery on off, SA lifts his bat and lets it through.
Leg bye! Good length ball, angling in, Sami looks to flick but it goes off his pads towards the leg side and they take a leg bye.

FOUR! Beautiful drive! Sami Aslam gets his first boundary and it's the first of the match as well. Slightly overpitched and hurled outside off, Sami Aslam leans into it and drives it through extra cover. Warner sprints behind the ball but the lightening outfield fetches the southpaw a boundary.
Comes a bit forward and keeps it out towards covers.
On a good length and just outside off, coming back in a touch as Sami looks to defend it off the front foot. Gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls away towards the off side.
Fuller and on the pads, flicked towards square leg.
Angles away a length ball outside off, Aslam shoulders his arms to that one. He will have to reload it again as he oversteps. So a no ball is called by the umpire.
Begins his spell with a length ball on middle and leg, Sami gets across and tucks it towards the man at short mid-wicket.
First bowling change of the day then, JACKSON BIRD is brought into the attack, replacing Starc.
Angles a length ball on middle, tucked towards short mid-wicket for nothing.
Very full and angling in, Ali drives it on the up back to the bowler who tries to stop it with his right hand but it bursts off his fingers towards mid off.
Hits the deck hard and angles it down the leg side. Ali sits under it.
Fuller and angling in, it's driven towards the man at mid on who dives to his left to stop it.
Fuller in length and moves away a bit, double A makes a good leave to Wade.
Outside off, Ali doesn't look at this one.
Good length delivery on off, Aslam defends it watchfully.
Angles in a length delivery on the hips, it's clipped towards backward square leg for an easy couple.
Stays behind the line and keeps it out.
SA has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Good length delivery, angling down leg, Aslam looks to clip it but the ball goes off something to the keeper. There was surely some noise but not of the wood.
Fuller in length and outside off, Sami presses forward and defends it with a solid straight bat.
A short leg is in place...
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller and comes back in again, Azhar looks to work it through the leg side but the bat twists in his hands and he ends up driving it back to the bowler.
in the corridor outside off, Ali lets it go.

Peach! Shane Warner on air screams - THIS IS THE LENGTH TO BOWL AT THE MCG! Fuller and angling in from outside off, Ali looks to drive it through covers but is beaten all ends up. Hazlewood is troubling him big time.

A LOUD SHOUT FOR LBW! Hazlewood serves a length ball on off and it nips back in sharply after pitching. Ali brings his front foot across and looks to leave this one alone. But the inward movement beats him and hits him on the pads. Josh turns back to appeal but the umpire shakes his head. They think about reviewing it but Smith from slips signals it might be a bit high and hence goes with the onfield call.
Fuller in length and angling in, worked towards the man at mid on.
Similar to the very first ball of the match. Sprays it down the leg side, Aslam tries to flick it down the leg side but fails to do so.
Short of a length ball and angling in, Sami hops and fends it away on the off side.
The southpaw shoulders arms to let that one through.
Back of a length delivery outside off, SA makes a good leave to the keeper.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Sami ducks under it to let that one sail over him to the keeper. Wade does well to collect it with a leap.

Brilliant bowling! And the outfield is lightening quick! Starc fires in a yorker on middle, it curls back in a bit. Ali brings his bat down in time and just about manages to jam this one out. It goes through mid-wicket and Jackson Bird chases it down just near the boundary rope. Another three picked up.
Fullish length ball on off, Sami presses forward and defends it down on the track.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Aslam prods forward and then leaves it alone.

Fuller and hurled on the pads, Ali gets across a bit and flicks it through mid-wicket. It was hit in the gap but the boundary is too big here. The fielder cuts it off and they take three. Pakistan are underway.
Fuller in length and once again moves away a bit, this time Azhar shows patience and lets it go.

Beaten! Hazlewood pitches this one up and lures Ali into a drive. He obliges but without any foot movement as the ball moves away a touch and just whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper. Perfect length to bowl at the MCG says the commentator on air.
Starts with a good length delivery on off, Ali gets across and defends it towards mid-wicket.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD to share the new cherry from the other end!
Nice carry! On a length and just outside off, Sami Aslam lifts his bat and allows it to go through to the keeper. A maiden to start the Boxing Day Test then.
Touch short and around middle and leg, Sami hops a bit in the crease and tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Keeps it full and serves it around off, SA stays behind the line once again and defends it down solidly.
Fuller and curling back in from outside off, Sami stays in line and defends it off the front foot.
Very full and hurls it on off, Aslam tries to jam it out but is a bit late in doing so.
Not a good start! Starc comes steaming in and sprays this one down the leg side. Aslam tries to flick it on its way but fails to do so.

It's time to get underway. And as expected the big crowd is in to watch this game. They are brimming in anticipation as the umpires and players make their way out to the middle. AZHAR ALI and SAMI ASLAM are the Pakistan openers. MITCHELL STARC to begin proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
TEAM CHANGES - Australia are unchanged from the last game. Pakistan have made 1 change - SOHAIL KHAN replaces Rahat Ali.
TOSS - Steven Smith flips the coin and Misbah-ul-Haq calls it correctly. PAKISTAN OPT TO BAT!

Pakistan on the other hand will be riding high on confidence despite the loss in the opening game. Scoring the highest fourth innings total in Brisbane and nearly chasing down 490 is a proud moment in itself. The Asian team needs their opening pair to fire and set the platform for the rest. The hosts have announced an unchanged XI, let's wait and see if there is any change for Pakistan. But for that the toss needs to happen. Stay with is as it is coming up in a short while...

The famous Boxing Day Test has arrived as Australia will be locking horns against Pakistan at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. The hosts lead the 3-match Test series 1-0 and would be looking to seal the deal and provide the fans with a perfect present on this special occasion.
